concept_selection.method: Python random.Random(seed).randrange(3); independent general-knowledge authorial alternatives written before local candidate access

options.concept: An overnight copyediting room where the red strike-through on a manuscript visibly continues into a doorway that has become blank paper; the character tries to preserve a last undeleted line.
A night train compartment whose window reveals the same compartment on an enormous printed manuscript page, and a reader discovers her movement written there.
An apartment entrance where proof-sheet crop marks cut across the real room, while a character holds a printed floor plan showing the same cut and an RPG agency counter.

selected.concept: An overnight copyediting room where the red strike-through on a manuscript visibly continues into a doorway that has become blank paper; the character tries to preserve a last undeleted line.

testcase_data.selection_reason: The seeded proofroom option supplies a physically shared writing/door boundary and a concrete lost exit; the train option risked reading as a picture within a picture, and crop marks risked reading as a graphic overlay. All remain legitimate independent alternatives rather than source-derived facts.
requester_owned: Focal topic from the exact prior-user title: metafiction, existential horror and LitRPG.
Use of supplied reference, realized in visible face and hair.
agent_owned: Proofroom, manuscript, red crossing, paper doorway, level/resource labels and their values, gesture, garment, lighting, camera and number of visible subjects.

criteria_at_native_pixels.criterion: A legible writing surface and the character's physical setting share a visible boundary or alteration; text must visibly intrude into the world, rather than merely sit in a decorative UI.
criteria_at_native_pixels.look_for: The manuscript stroke connects to a red crossing on a paper-converted doorway, with prose/paper texture entering the real wall.
criteria_at_native_pixels.claim_limit: Visual correspondence can support authored-world intrusion; it cannot prove an unseen author performed an earlier edit.

criteria_at_native_pixels.criterion: The altered environment visibly removes or threatens an ordinary affordance the person needs, and the person's directed response relates to it.
criteria_at_native_pixels.look_for: A doorway occupied by blank paper, the head/gaze toward it, parted lips and bracing posture.
criteria_at_native_pixels.claim_limit: Fear may be inferred cautiously from visible reaction; a single expression does not prove private beliefs or lifelong existential understanding.

criteria_at_native_pixels.criterion: A compact role-playing level/resource cue is readable and connected to the protagonist's agency predicament.
criteria_at_native_pixels.look_for: LEVEL 08 and AGENCY 0/10 near the wrist with the same red revision accent.
criteria_at_native_pixels.claim_limit: One value cannot establish a prior level-up, a mechanical update or the rules across time.

criteria_at_native_pixels.criterion: The central face and hair retain the reference's visible contour, eye/nose/lip character and dark bob with separated bangs at useful size.
criteria_at_native_pixels.look_for: Face and hair resemblance from direct side-by-side appearance review, with clothing and scene authored separately.
criteria_at_native_pixels.claim_limit: Appearance resemblance supplies no actual identity, age, personality, consent or biography.

criteria_at_native_pixels.criterion: The page, person's response and paper-converted exit read together in one coherent photograph.
criteria_at_native_pixels.look_for: A clear page/face/door visual triangle, visible hands and enough contrast/depth.
criteria_at_native_pixels.claim_limit: This is an artistic/situational observation, not a new universal hard gate.

single_frame_unverifiable: Whether the deletion happened before the shutter or changed the character's actual fate.
Whether an external real author exists, acts with intention or controls this fictional world.
Whether the displayed agency value used to be higher, or whether an RPG system genuinely enforces choice.
Whether the character understands the whole ontological situation or can later escape.
testcase_data.planned_comparison: After DATA-READY, review all returned sources and compare complete compatible local alternatives with this baseline at creativity 1. Distinguish requester fidelity, visible scene evidence and overall preference.

generation_budget.blocked_policy: A block without returned pixels remains blocked_unscored; no alternate model/API/CLI route.

testcase_data.random_method: Python secrets.randbits(64), then random.Random(seed).choice once per authored pool; pool construction and scene realization use general knowledge.

testcase_data.concept: The disabled departure: the real wrist ends as a selectable hand icon in the protagonist's own RPG command panel while a matching avatar obeys WAIT.
testcase_data.user_scope: Exact request and topic_context; face/hair appearance from actual supplied photo. The chosen mechanism and all random details remain agent-owned.

precore_alternatives.realization: A solid command bar obstructs the gate.
precore_alternatives.comparison: Clear access restriction but weak self-representation; could read as an ordinary magical barricade.

precore_alternatives.realization: A menu command strip physically steers a real wrist.
precore_alternatives.comparison: Clear bodily control but could read as an external restraint rather than a character becoming interface material.

precore_alternatives.realization: Chosen baseline: wrist transitions into the disabled tile while its own player portrait waits.
precore_alternatives.comparison: Links human embodiment, command distinction and a representation of this same character through one event.

must_coexist: flat selectable hand in that same tile
native_pixel_observations.pass_rule: All owners, contact and transition visible together at saved native resolution; a hovering menu beside an ordinary hand is insufficient.

must_coexist: protagonist attempting to leave or pull free
native_pixel_observations.pass_rule: The selected/disabled distinction and local resistance read together. If letters fail, report impaired command legibility separately from color states.

must_coexist: same-face/bob player portrait on the controlling panel
native_pixel_observations.pass_rule: Both real person and player portrait remain distinguishable and visibly correspond within one frame; text labels alone do not prove correspondence.

must_coexist: gaze or facial response directed toward trapped wrist
native_pixel_observations.pass_rule: The expression is connected to the relevant obstruction, not an unrelated scared portrait.
Review actual face/hair similarity at the achieved image scale; do not claim verified identity.

unscorable_claims: Actual free will, consciousness, metaphysical truth, narrator authority and the person's consent or personality are not decidable from pixels.
A matching player portrait and constrained body can support a metafictional/agency-loss reading; they do not establish the full imagined backstory.
The artifact is not user acceptance.

concept_seed.role: Independent authorial selection, not requester constraint

testcase_data.concept: The coat-check claim to a remaining self
testcase_data.selection_reason: A familiar unattended counter makes the treatment of a person as a retrievable stored record immediately bureaucratic and intimate. The random seeded choice selected identity coat-check over the portrait-booth and bookbinding alternatives; its emptiness gives the single sitter and record room to read.
testcase_data.request_topic_resolution: Actual prior-user title: 메타픽션 실존공포 LitRPG 조사. Current request asks an independently random suitable concept and a reference-guided image test.

components: Dark chin-length bob and fine bangs
required_visible_components.relation: The real subject and the intact recorded portrait share a readable visual likeness; appearance reference only.

components: Physical claim sheet held by the woman
A printed same-counter scene with the woman holding the same sheet
A second smaller sheet within the printed scene
required_visible_components.relation: At least one nested same-scene/same-prop relation is visible, so the record refers to the present encounter.

components: Three portraits repeating the same bob and garment collar
Progression from complete face to interrupted face to almost blank head
required_visible_components.relation: The record visibly loses personal detail while the living subject remains present and attends to the loss.

components: Game-character panel integrated into the claim sheet
required_visible_components.relation: Progression/state/resource and a save action belong to the same character record, not a detached decorative HUD.

components: Right thumb touching nearly erased portrait
required_visible_components.relation: The subject responds physically to the threatened recorded self with coherent contact, reach and support.

pixel_scoring.pass: All components and named relations of a component gate are visible together.
pixel_scoring.partial: Some components are supported but one or more connections or legible details are missing.
pixel_scoring.fail: A visible image contradicts or omits the relation.
pixel_scoring.blocked_unscored: No returned pixels; do not use textual receipts as pixel evidence.

non_pixel_claims_not_scored: The printed state determines her metaphysical identity
This is the same consciousness across saves
A restore choice has already changed the world
The subject really has the biography or personality imagined for the scene
planned_observation_limits: Nested photographs may be too small to prove recursion; score partial if only a generic miniature portrait is visible.
Game text must be read from returned pixels; prompt labels are not evidence.
A blank portrait supports record erasure, not literal erasure of a real mind.

precore_comparison.tradeoff: Could read as ordinary successive snapshots.

precore_comparison.strength: Stored self, an unattended claim procedure and record loss become one relation
precore_comparison.tradeoff: Depends on sheet projection and sparse readable interface.
Several hands and pages could overwhelm the face and continuity relation.

testcase_data.ownership: Specific counter, claim sheet, portraits, clothing, lighting, gesture, layout and camera are agent staging and remain replaceable within the broad topic and reference scope.
